summary: Backend-only regression testing for AP00-AP03 hardening (T01/R03/T02/T03/T06/AP03). Wrote pytest suite tests/test_hardening_regression.py covering all requested paths: health, admin login/verify, watchdog status contract (no 500 when Bitunix not configured), dynamic strategies list/confirm/dismiss, risk-budget, regime-lab base routes, and 13 core GET endpoints (parametrised no-500 checks). Serial run: 25/25 passed (2 initially skipped because DB had no dynamic_strategies; after seeding a TEST_ doc, both passed and verified 400 'Kein offener Regime-Wechsel'/dismiss 200). Additionally re-ran KI_OFFLINE_TESTS=1 analysis_regression suite: 54/54 passed. No 500s, no regressions detected on the hardened paths.

minor.issue: Parallel pytest-xdist run against the preview URL caused occasional ReadTimeouts on /api/health and /api/dynamic/current-regime under concurrent load; serial run is stable. Not a product bug – flag for future test harness (use -n 0 for external URL) or higher timeouts.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/dynamic.py: transition_protect is wrapped in broad except Exception during /confirm (line ~177). This is intentional (best-effort scoped protection per AP01/R03) but silently degrades to apply without protection. Consider surfacing the failure in the response payload (e.g. transition: {status: 'failed', reason: str(e)}) so the operator sees the degradation instead of only warning logs.
backend/routers/dynamic.py: /api/dynamic/list clamps to 100 rows without pagination; fine for MVP but should paginate before growth.
The requested public GET route 'GET /api/dynamic' does not exist – only /api/dynamic/list. If external callers/UI expect the shorter path, add an alias; otherwise document accordingly.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded dynamic_strategies with id=TEST_dyn_confirm to validate 400 confirm path; deleted afterwards. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_hardening_regression.py is the canonical regression suite for the AP00-AP03 hardening. Run it serially with `python -m pytest tests/test_hardening_regression.py -o addopts= -v` (default pytest.ini enables xdist which can cause external-URL timeouts). All hardened paths verified: watchdog/status no 500 when Bitunix unconfigured, dynamic/confirm returns 400 (not 500) without pending_switch, dismiss is idempotent, risk-budget response OK. No live-order (write) endpoints were touched. Live analysis_regression offline suite still 54/54 green.
